leading_hypothesis.name: writing as image / private lossy visual mnemonic notation
leading_hypothesis.surface_claim: The surface imitates Western/Latin-script handwriting texture without a demonstrated recoverable ordinary-language or classical-cipher mapping.

licensed: H20 is the leading working hypothesis, not a decipherment.
The surface is organised and designed rather than independent randomness.
Direct bounded language mapping and bounded paragraph-terminal point models are unsupported.
The next discriminator must be image-grounded and held-out.
